source_documented_facts: Dataset title: Appropriate Crop Recommendation Dataset for Cultivation in Bangladesh using IoT and Machine Learning (CropRec-BD v1, 2025)
Metadata states collection in Bangladesh using IoT sensors, farmer surveys, agricultural records, BARI and NASA sources.
Metadata states roughly 3,000 records for nine crops.
Downloaded file list contains final_crops_data.csv only.
inferences_from_data_patterns: Actual downloaded CSV has 2,892 rows, 5 columns, and 9 crop classes.
Actual file contains only Soil, Soil_Moisture, Humidity, Temperature, and Crop Name.
Soil is a perfectly scaled duplicate of Soil_Moisture.
Soil_Moisture has strongly crop-specific ranges, suggesting strong dataset construction or agronomic grouping; leakage is not proven from file contents alone.
Humidity and Temperature are rounded to two decimals; Soil_Moisture is integer-valued.
